question: Where did the Indian Air Force participate in the multinational air exercise INIOCHOS-25?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andravida Air Base, Greece.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Indian Air Force will participate in Exercise INIOCHOS-25 at Andravida Air Base in Greece from March 31 to April 11, 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• INIOCHOS-25 is a biennial multinational air exercise hosted by the Hellenic Air Force at Andravida Air Base, Greece.
 
• The exercise will enhance international cooperation and interoperability among participating air forces.
 
• India will participate with Su-30 MKI fighters and other support aircraft like IL-78 & C-17.
 
• IAF’s involvement strengthens its operational capabilities and contributes to mutual learning and enhanced military coordination.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• INIOCHOS Exercise__

 __
 
• INIOCHOS is a biennial multinational air exercise focusing on air warfare, involving air forces from various countries.
 
 
 
• Su-30 MKI Fighters__
 __
 
• The Su-30 MKI is a multirole fighter aircraft used by the Indian Air Force, known for its versatility and combat capabilities.
 
 
 
• IL-78 Aircraft__
 __
 
• IL-78 is an aerial refueling tanker aircraft used to extend the operational range of fighter jets.
 
 
 
• C-17 Aircraft__
 
 
• The C-17 Globemaster III is a large military transport aircraft used by the IAF for heavy cargo and troop movements.
